title: UpdateOutputRequest
description: Body of `PATCH /api/outputs/:id`. Both fields are optional — absent means unchanged. `config`, when present, is merged into the stored config one level deep for `legend`/`tooltip`/`seriesColors`/`axisLabels` (HEL-877) rather than replacing it wholesale.

config.description: Output config. `compare` (HEL-1273) selects the history comparison: absent/null (none), `previous_run`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, or `custom:<d>` where <d> is a positive ISO-8601 duration in days/hours/minutes/seconds (PnDTnHnMnS, at most 365 days; week/month/year and lowercase/signed forms are rejected). Anything else is a 400.
